name: Alias cast without GetReference
description: Flags casting a Quest Alias / ReferenceAlias / LocationAlias directly to Actor, ObjectReference, Location, or another non-Alias type. Aliases are not the filled form; use GetReference(), GetActorReference(), or GetLocation(). Casting an Alias to another *Alias type, or to a script that extends an alias type, is allowed.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, an explicit `as` cast whose value's known type is a Quest alias (`Alias`, `ReferenceAlias`, `LocationAlias`, `RefCollectionAlias`, or a type that extends one of those) and whose target is not itself an alias type (the target name is not `Alias` / `ReferenceAlias` / `LocationAlias` / `RefCollectionAlias` does not end with `Alias`, and does not resolve to a script whose `Extends` chain reaches one of those alias types). That pattern treats the alias object as if it were the filled reference (`(MyAlias as Actor).Kill()`), which is always `None` at runtime; the filled form is reached with `GetReference()`, `GetActorReference()`, or `GetLocation()` depending on the alias kind. A cast of an alias to another alias type (`Alias as ReferenceAlias`, `ReferenceAlias as MyQuestAlias`), or to a script that extends an alias type (`(MyAlias as MyBossBattle)` where `MyBossBattle extends ReferenceAlias`), is left quiet, since that cast reaches the alias's own script, which `GetReference()` would not. Only a cast whose value type can be determined locally is checked; a member access or call result is left unflagged rather than guessed at. Primitive and array casts are ignored.
